description: Create a webhook subscription (Pro plan only, max 5 active). FAQai will POST signed JSON payloads to the URL when the subscribed events fire. The response includes the signing secret ONCE — tell the user to store it securely; it cannot be retrieved again. Events: document.uploaded, document.completed, document.failed, document.cancelled, dataset.exported (defaults to all).

url.description: HTTPS endpoint that will receive webhook POSTs

title: Create Webhook
